actions.text: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 20 - 15.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal employees transferred between agencies, program administrators, and participants in the four transferred education and school safety programs nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: Additionally, the bill transfers to HHS all personnel and appropriations related to the functions that are transferred under this bill.

dimensions.assessment: Involves an administrative and organizational realignment of specific federal programs, personnel, and funds between two cabinet-level departments without altering the underlying program rules.
dimensions.evidence: The transfer of these functions does not affect any suits, proceedings, or applications for benefits, services, licenses, permits, certificates, or financial assistance

dimensions.assessment: Transfers existing appropriations and unexpended fund balances associated with the specified programs, while requiring OMB to ensure no net increase in full-time equivalent employees.
dimensions.evidence: the personnel employed in connection with, and the assets, liabilities, contracts, property, records, and unexpended balances of appropriations... shall be transferred

dimensions.assessment: Broadly shifts administrative jurisdiction, legal authorities, and management responsibilities for four distinct federal grant and activity programs from ED to HHS.
dimensions.evidence: There are transferred to the Secretary of Health and Human Services all the functions which the Secretary of Education exercised... with respect to each of the following

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent structural transfer of agency functions and program administration taking effect six months post-enactment.
dimensions.evidence: this Act shall take effect 6 months after the date of enactment of this Act

missing_information: The exact dollar amounts of appropriations and exact counts of personnel being transferred are not listed in the source text.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill transfers four specific elementary and secondary education family engagement and school support programs, along with their personnel and appropriations, from the Department of Education to the Department of Health and Human Services.
